# Learnova AI

> Learnova AI is an all-in-one study platform for students in Bangladesh. It offers AI-generated study plans, note-taking, flashcards, an AI study assistant chat, English language practice with Bangla explanations, focus mode, and progress tracking. Free accounts include daily limits; Premium unlocks higher limits and extra features.

## Main sections

- [Home](/): Overview of features and how Learnova works
- [Sign up](/sign-up): Create a free student account
- [Sign in](/sign-in): Access your account

## Key features

- AI Study Plans: personalized daily study schedules by class level (NCTB curriculum aware)
- AI Study Assistant: chat with an AI tutor in English or Bangla
- English Practice: vocabulary and grammar exercises with Bangla explanations (10 min/day free, 30 min/day Premium)
- Focus Mode: distraction-free study timer with focus scoring
- Notes & Flashcards: create and review study materials
- Progress Tracking: streaks, stats, and study history

## Plans

- Free: core features with daily limits
- Premium: higher limits, unlimited AI assistant, strict focus mode, 30 min/day English practice
